about_the_game:
This is your Lucky Break, you have matched with tree beautiful woman and now planning to go on dates with them and find the one! Or not, choice is yours.

Step into the shoes of an everyday construction worker whose luck is about to change dramatically. After months of digital silence on dating apps, fate delivers an unexpected gift: three stunning matches in a single day. Each woman is unique, mysterious, and interested in meeting you. 

Demo contains first date with Alexandra, mysterious analyst from prominent investment back.

Languages: English, Spanish, Portuguese, German, French, Italian, Russian.

🎯 Your Choices Shape Everything

  • Meaningful Decisions: Every dialogue choice and action influences how your date unfolds

  • Dynamic Storytelling: Multiple conversation paths lead to different outcomes

  • Replayable Romance: Explore different choices to unlock new scenes and endings

✨ Key Features

  • Cinematic FMV Experience:  video scenes with voice bring characters to life

  • Mature Romance: Suggestive but tasteful content designed for adult audiences

  • Choice-Driven Narrative: Your decisions create unique romantic storylines

  • Multiple Endings: Different relationship outcomes based on your dating choices

  • Atmospheric Soundtrack: Immersive audio that enhances every romantic moment

  • Autotranslated to Spanish, Portuguese, German, French, Italian and Russian.

content_descriptors.notes: Depicts dating with some mildly suggestive language.
